title: The Japan Times
description: The Japan Times is a leading English-language news outlet that provides comprehensive coverage of Japan's business, politics, culture, sports, and entertainment. It offers various subscription options, including digital and print formats, catering to a diverse audience interested in Japanese news and insights. The company also features specialized services such as academic and business subscriptions, as well as access to its digital archives. Its intended clients include local and international readers seeking reliable information about Japan and its global interactions.
